newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Van Ommeren buys 50 pct of Indian firm.
newsitem.headline: Van Ommeren buys 50 pct of Indian firm.

text.p: Shipping and tank storage firm Koninklijke Van Ommeren NV said it would invest an initial $8.5 million to take a 50 percent stake in tank storage firm United Storage & Tank Terminals Ltd, a unit of India's IMC Ltd.
The company, which will be renamed United Van Ommeren Tank Terminals (UVOTT), operates terminals in the cities of Kandla, Karwar and Goa.

It plans a substantial increase of its storage capacity for chemicals, mineral and edible oil products and gases in the next three years, which will require a total investment of about $33 million, Van Ommeren said.
The Dutch group said India's economic development and trade liberalisation offered prospects of much higher import and export volumes.
It added that UVOTT wanted to be actively involved in developing new terminals in India, in which the firm could use Van Ommeren's global experience.

Van Ommeren said UVOTT would have an operational and marketing cooperation with the 12 other terminals that IMC operates in India. Further cooperation is being studied, the Dutch group said without elaborating.
